debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r s-t-a-r-t-e-d a f-a-k-e l-o-n-g-d-i-s-t-a-n-c-e r-o-m-a-n-c-e c-h-a-n-n-e-l and l-e-f-t a s-e-r-i-e-s of f-l-a-t-t-e-n-i-n-g m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
2) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-l-l-e-c-t-e-d e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s t-h-r-o-u-g-h u-r-g-e-n-t a-p-p-e-a-l-s and l-e-f-t a t-r-a-i-l of p-l-e-d-g-e-d b-o-n-d-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l a-u-d-i-t
3) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d m-o-n-e-y m-u-l-e-s f-o-r f-u-n-d t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-s and l-e-f-t a n-e-t-w-o-r-k of c-o-m-p-l-i-c-i-t-y a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g l-a-w-f-u-l c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e
4) the a-c-t-o-r i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t-e-d i-s-o-l-a-t-i-o-n t-a-c-t-i-c-s t-o p-r-e-v-e-n-t v-i-c-t-i-m c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n and l-e-f-t a r-e-g-i-m-e of i-n-d-i-v-i-d-u-a-l f-e-a-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g o-p-e-n c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
5) the a-c-t-o-r d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d t-h-e s-c-h-e-m-e i-n m-i-n-u-t-e-s b-d-0-2-1 and l-e-f-t a p-a-p-e-r t-r-a-i-l of f-i-l-e-d c-l-a-i-m-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g e-t-h-i-c-a l-r-e-v-i-e-w
